candidates.requirement: Call xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler on the XInclude context so this target reaches the newly supported context-specific error-handler mechanism.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates xinc with xmlXIncludeNewContext(doc), can register a handler on that same xinc, and then calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode(xinc, (xmlNodePtr) doc). The old route goes directly from creation to setting flags and processing.
candidates.failure_condition: For a finite encoded main document such as <a/>, a nonnull context is zero-initialized. The complete old entry never calls the new setter, so no input executes its handler-registration behavior or supplies a context handler to the changed error dispatch.
candidates.alternative_paths: The global generic error function is a different registration. xmlXIncludeSetFlags only stores parse flags; context creation clears the handler fields. The complete target contains no equivalent context setter call.
